## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a6876cc8848156e3fcaae109b90417402ef8d6d2`
Local-runs: none
Scope: `scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs`, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` + none

No path of the diff is a governed-register or published-schema hit (all three sit under `scripts/`; the register rows are `docs/adr/`, `.claude/`, `skills/`, the root instruction files, `.github/workflows/` and their `ui/` twins). Scope is widened to the whole diff. Read: card #34086 with its triage, claim 6899732043, amendment 6899828745 and os-dev-report 6900376734; the PR body, file list and net diff against merge base `f81e4b6c`; the head's check-runs; PR #34080's hunk ranges. Nothing was built, run or re-run. The acceptance numbers (33 → 34 lines, 8 → 9 always-runs families, about 11 s) are the dev's measurements, checked here by reading and against CI, not reproduced.

Check-runs on the head: all completed, none still running. 26 success, the rest skipped (opt-in and UI lanes), 0 failed. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Check Changeset` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` are among the green ones.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Marker grammar: holds.** `scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs:1188` is one whole-line `// dispatch-gates: whole-tree-population -- REASON` comment, the same form as the 7 existing carrier sources (`check-nul-bytes`, `check-closing-keyword-parity`, `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `check-driver-memory-census`, `check-gitlink-declared`, `check-refd-timer-probe`, `check-watch-hint-literal`). The diff changes no marker parser. Carrier SOURCE FILES go 7 → 8 by reading; the PR's 8 → 9 counts always-runs FAMILY rows, which is a measurement not reproduced here (one source can back more than one family row). The two counts agree on the delta of one.
- **Scan is whole-tree: holds.** `collectCitations` is `execFileSync('git', ['grep', '--untracked', '-IonE', pattern], { cwd: ROOT })` with no pathspec. The marker's reason describes it accurately.
- **`live-scan-population-is-declared` binds both ways, by reading:** remove the marker line and `declared` is false while the live scan reads many top-level roots, so the case is red; narrow the scan to one root under a surviving marker and `declared` is true against a one-root scan, so it is red. Line 1188 is the only line in the file the case's regex can match (the regex literal itself at line 2147 is indented and does not start a line with `//`). See nit N1 for the limit of the second direction.
- **Floor 21 → 22: justified.** The battery is the structural cases plus one per `KNOWN_NUMBER_COLLISIONS` row (3 today); the floor pins structural + 1. One structural case is added, so structural goes 20 → 21 and the floor 21 → 22. The comment's "a floor at 24 would redden a removal" is 21 + 3 and is consistent.
- **Limb D is append-only: holds.** +12 / −0 in `dispatch-gates.mjs`, one object appended after index 2; indexes 0–2 are byte-identical. `repoRootWalkSpelling` returns the FIRST match, so a source that already matched A, B or C keeps its label.
- **Limb D shape: holds.** `/['"`]git['"`]\s*,\s*\[[^\]]*?['"`]grep['"`]/` needs a quoted `git` followed by an array literal holding a quoted `grep` before the first `]`. It is command-agnostic, so `spawnSync('git', ['grep'` and `execFileSync('git', ['-C', root, 'grep'` both match; the bare `spawnSync('grep', [...])` in `check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs` does not; `'--grep'` does not.
- **What limb D reaches beyond the declarer.** `entry.rootWalk` is set for EVERY family, declared or not, and feeds the `unnamedRootWalk` census, which reds on an undeclared, unplaced root walker absent from `ROOT_WALK_RESIDUE_LEDGER`. So limb D widens that census as well as the marker's liveness check, and that direction is derive-MORE. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` is green with no ledger row added, so no other discovered gate family became a new unlisted walker.
- **Acceptance: holds by reading.** A declared family whose own source carries a recognised walk is placed `always-runs` by `placeFamily`, and its command is inside the runnable union `--commands` prints, for any path list including `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`. The live self-test case "every live whole-tree declaration is BACKED by a repo-root walk" is green in CI with `check:adr-anchors` among the declarers, so the marker is not refused.
- **NOT governed: holds.** 0 of 3 paths under a register row; size +59 / −4.

### ② Semver level

None. Three unpublished tool scripts under `scripts/`; no package, no published schema, no exported API. `skip-changeset` is right and `Check Changeset` is green. `Clause-②: no` is right: nothing is narrowed for a consumer. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Deviation — file-surface breach (`dispatch-gates.mjs` and its self-test): answered, accepted.** Amendment 6899828745 was posted on the card before the report and names exactly these two files as append-only. The diff conforms: zero deleted lines in either file, one array entry and two fixture cases. The route is the one the refusal text itself prescribes (extend `REPO_ROOT_WALK_SPELLINGS` with a self-test case beside it); rewriting the scan to `ls-files` to satisfy limb A would have routed around the check.
- **Route choice (whole-tree, not wide-population, not a narrowed scan): answered, accepted.** `wide-population` keeps a family OUT of `--commands`, the opposite of the card's defect. Narrowing the scan would drop check #6634's purpose.
- **Always-runs for every card — over-derivation? Answered: no, this is the intended reading.** The channel's own contract is "a gate every card implicates is a gate this card owes", and any text file in any card can add an `ADR-NNNN` citation, the same standing as `check:nul-bytes`. The price is one command on every card (about 11 s, dev-measured). The error direction is derive-MORE.
- **open_questions:** none in the report.
- **Out-of-scope note — serial with PR #34080 and card #34084: answered.** PR #34080 (open, head `b8685e50`) touches `dispatch-gates.mjs` at lines 6572, 7889, 8010, 13527, 16361 and 16378, and the self-test at 300, 1394, 1482 and 9170. This PR touches 4071 and 6871. No hunk overlaps or abuts; a textual conflict is not expected in either landing order. #34080's patch adds no line naming the whole-tree channel, the always-runs count or `REPO_ROOT_WALK_SPELLINGS`, so no pinned count there moves. `main` has advanced from `f81e4b6c` to `385ea1cc` with no change to any of the three files. Card #34084 has no PR yet that could be read, so its regions are unverified; "the second to land resolves" stands for it.
- **SQL push-down:** not applicable; no data access in the diff.
- **No carrier is owed for the report's out-of-scope note.** One follow-up is suggested by S1 below; filing it is the seat's call.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix.

**should-fix (non-blocking, follow-up)**

- **S1 — limb D admits a pathspec-narrowed `git grep`, and the amendment's census sentence is narrower than it reads.** Amendment 6899828745 says "on the tree it matches `scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs` only". Read across the head's whole tree, the regex also matches 10 non-fixture files, every one a `git grep` WITH a pathspec, so none is a whole-tree walk: `ui/scripts/measure-strict-authoring-face.mjs:876`, `packages/core/src/security/granted-permissions-not-enforced.pin.test.ts:100`, `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-vi-mock-inherit.test.ts:1321`, `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/relatedListParentScopeResidue-8937.test.ts:238`, and six files under `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/`. The sentence is true of gate sources under `scripts/`. No harm today: none of them carries the marker, the green census shows none became an unlisted walker, and a false whole-tree claim derives MORE for that family and removes nothing from any other family's columns (`placeFamily` leaves non-declaring families untouched). It is also the looseness limb A already has (`'ls-files', 'packages'` passes it), and the limb's own comment states "necessary, not sufficient". But "judged by a reader" is the only guard, and the pathspec form is the majority spelling in this tree. Suggested: refuse an argv holding a `'--'` element after `'grep'`, or pin one fixture case stating that a pathspec'd `git grep` passes and why.

**nit**

- **N1 — the self-test's second direction is "more than one top-level root", not "no pathspec".** A scan narrowed to two or more roots under a surviving marker stays green. The error is toward derive-MORE, so it is safe, but the comment "holds the marker to the scan in both directions" claims more than the predicate does.
- **N2 — fixture coverage of limb D.** One positive (`execFileSync`) and one negative (system `grep`), as the amendment promised. No case pins `spawnSync('git', ['grep'`, which matches, and none pins the misses: a `git([...])` helper (`packages/core/src/security/*.pin.test.ts`), an argv built in a variable, a nested `]` before `'grep'`, or a shell-form `git grep` (`scripts/ci/select-gate-families.sh`). Every miss fails loud for a declarer (refusal), which is the documented direction; for a non-declarer it leaves the unnamed-walker census exactly where it was before this PR.
- **N3 — the self-test's marker regex accepts only the column-0 `//` form**, while the grammar also takes docblock and block-comment forms. Moving the marker into a docblock would redden the case while `dispatch-gates` still reads it. Loud, never silent.
- **N4 — hint count.** The card and triage say 5 path hints; the PR and report say 4 path literals. Not reconciled anywhere. It has no effect on the fix.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-g15lbf`
Reviewed-by: `session_01ADHkmPd7uRqHauEehGPr19`

**VERDICT: PASS**

The marker uses the existing grammar, with no parser change; the self-test goes red if either the marker or the whole-tree scan goes; limb D is append-only with indexes 0–2 byte-identical; no hunk overlaps PR #34080's.

Nits N1–N4 carried (the self-test binds "more than one root" rather than "no pathspec"; no fixture for the `spawnSync` form; a column-0-only marker regex in the self-test; the 4 vs 5 hint count).
- **范围外去向:** S1 (limb D admits a pathspec-narrowed `git grep`; it fails toward deriving more) → added to #34084, which owns `dispatch-gates.mjs` next.
- **落地:** K = 3 (PRBASE `f81e4b6c`). Not governed → ready + auto-merge by this seat.
